segments.name: Hard discount retail
segments.evidence: He supervises the Company's performance as a single business unit, therefore, the Company has only one operating segment (See Note 23).

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for grocery products sold in its stores, plus revenue from sales of recyclables such as cardboard and stretch film.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales of recyclables (cardboard and stretch film primarily), are recognized as revenue when control of the products sold has been transferred to the customer.
